statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Late-session Nasdaq weakness has deepened after an earlier retracement while yields, oil and breadth remain adverse.
recommendation: The mapped policy state is BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES; Tail is moderately above threshold because downside re-extended into the late session with multiple current cross-asset amplifiers, while detailed NQ bar-level retracement evidence remains incomplete.
headline: Late-session downside extension keeps Tail above the block threshold
body: The latest market update has the Nasdaq about 1.1% lower near two-week lows after an earlier midday retracement. Negative breadth, a 10-year Treasury yield near 4.70%, Brent above $93, and fresh supporting context showing seven of eight tracked megacaps lower and five of seven tracked semiconductors lower reinforce the downside regime. Tail is elevated but not high because detailed independent NQ pullback structure remains incomplete.
